message.content: Hey, I need to send out the final invoice for the Van der Merwedie wedding shoot. Can you draft it up?

content.text: Sure. I have the project details from last month. The agreed rate was R45,000 for the full day coverage plus the engagement session. Should I include the 15% early payment discount since they paid the deposit on time?

message.content: Yes, please apply that. It’s only R6,750 off, but it’s good for the relationship. Also, make sure the payment terms are clearly listed as 14 days via EFT.

content.text: Noted. I’ve set the terms to Net 14. I’m attaching the itemized breakdown: the base fee, the engagement session add-on, and the post-production retouching package. Does the breakdown look correct to you?

message.content: Looks good. Just double-check the total. R45,000 minus 15%... that’s R38,250. Right?

content.text: That’s correct. The final amount due is R38,250. I’ve also added a note about the digital gallery link being active for 90 days. Shall I send it to them now or do you want to review the PDF first?

message.content: Send it. And while you’re at it, can you remind me about the lens maintenance? I think I need to clean the sensor on the Canon before the food shoot on Friday.

content.text: I’ve sent the invoice to the Van der Merwedes. Regarding the lens, I see a note in your gear log that you last cleaned the sensor on February 20th. Given the high humidity in Cape Town lately, a quick check wouldn't hurt. Do you want me to pull up the sensor cleaning tutorial from last time?

message.content: No need for the video. I know how to do it. Just make sure the backup drive is formatted and ready for Friday’s shoot. I’ll handle the sensor.

content.text: Understood. I’ve formatted the external SSD and verified the free space. It’s ready for the food shoot data. Is there anything else you need before you head out?
